library.title: Library
library.unsupportedBrowser: This browser doesn't support the file access needed to import manga. Use Chrome or Edge (also on Android).

notice.relinked_one: 1 chapter was in the library without its linked file (e.g. from a restored backup) and has been reconnected.
notice.relinked_other: {{count}} chapters were in the library without their linked file (e.g. from a restored backup) and have been reconnected.
notice.duplicates_one: 1 file was already in the library and was skipped.
notice.duplicates_other: {{count}} files were already in the library and were skipped.
notice.corrupted_one: 1 file is not a valid archive (or contains no images) and was skipped.
notice.corrupted_other: {{count}} files are not valid archives (or contain no images) and were skipped.
notice.unsupported_one: 1 file is in an unsupported format ({{types}}) and was skipped. Accepted formats: {{formats}}.
notice.unsupported_other: {{count}} files are in unsupported formats ({{types}}) and were skipped. Accepted formats: {{formats}}.
notice.encrypted_one: 1 archive is password-protected and can't be read: it was skipped.
notice.encrypted_other: {{count}} archives are password-protected and can't be read: they were skipped.
notice.timeout_one: The archive reader didn't start in time for 1 file, which was skipped: try again or reload the app.
notice.timeout_other: The archive reader didn't start in time for {{count}} files, which were skipped: try again or reload the app.

library.feedback: Imported: {{imported}} · Reconnected: {{relinked}} · Duplicates skipped: {{duplicates}} · Unreadable: {{unreadable}} · Unsupported: {{ignored}}

library.uncategorizedCta: Tap to assign them to a series
library.noUncategorized: No chapters waiting to be categorized.

importing.title: Importing…

catalog.deleteSeriesNote: Its volumes and chapters will be removed too.
catalog.deleteVolumeNote: Its chapters will be removed too.
catalog.fileGoneRemoved: The file is no longer available and was removed from the library.

catalog.deleteFailed_one: Removed from the library. {{count}} file couldn't be deleted from the device.
catalog.deleteFailed_other: Removed from the library. {{count}} files couldn't be deleted from the device.
catalog.resultsCapped: Showing the first {{count}} chapters: narrow your search to see the rest.
catalog.unreadNote: Reading progress of all its chapters will be reset, including progress made by actually reading.

tagsDialog.title: Tags of {{title}}
tagsDialog.hint: Free words to group series (e.g. shonen, ongoing).

deleteDialog.question: The physical file on the device:

deleteDialog.deleteFile: Also delete the file from the device

bulkCategorize.sameVolume: Same volume for all selected chapters
bulkCategorize.existingVolumes: Volumes already in this series: {{numbers}}. The same number uses that volume, a different one creates a new volume.

errors.rowVolume: Enter a valid volume number for “{{fileName}}”.
errors.rowNumber: Enter a valid chapter number for “{{fileName}}”.

bulkCategorize.numbersFromFiles_one: The chapter number of 1 file was filled in from its name: please check it.
bulkCategorize.numbersFromFiles_other: The chapter number of {{count}} files was filled in from their names: please check them.

fileCheck.title: File check
fileCheck.removeNote: Removing them from the library only removes the references, with their reading progress: the files are not touched.
fileCheck.unverified_one: 1 file can't be checked without your permission: it's verified when you open the chapter.
fileCheck.unverified_other: {{count}} files can't be checked without your permission: they're verified when you open the chapters.
fileCheck.withoutHandle_one: 1 chapter has no linked file (restored from a backup): re-import the file to link it again.
fileCheck.withoutHandle_other: {{count}} chapters have no linked file (restored from a backup): re-import the files to link them again.

rename.volumeNote: A volume only has a number: its chapters stay where they are.

errors.duplicateSeries: A series with this title already exists.
errors.duplicateVolume: This series already has a volume with this number.

categorizeForm.title: Categorize

errors.chooseSeries: Choose a series (or create a new one).
errors.chooseVolume: Choose a volume (or create a new one).

categorizeForm.numberFromFile: Number taken from the file name: please check it.

readingSections.removeNote: The chapter stays in the library: it only leaves "In progress" and "Recently read", along with any manual bookmark.

notice.fileGone: The file is no longer available.

reader.noImagesFound: No images found in this file.
reader.invalidFile: Couldn't read the file: it doesn't look like a valid archive ({{format}}).
reader.encryptedFile: The file is password-protected and can't be read.
reader.archiveTimeout: The archive reader didn't start in time. Try again or reload the app.
reader.permissionNotGranted: File access permission not granted. Go back to the library and tap the chapter again.
reader.chapterOpenError: Couldn't open the chapter: the file may have been moved or deleted.

settings.appearanceHint: Choose how the logo at the top and the navigation menu look. Your choices stay on this device.
settings.backupHint: Export your entire library (series, volumes, chapters, reading progress, favorites) to a file you can keep or transfer to another device.
settings.backupModeFullHint: Also includes chapter thumbnails. Estimated size: {{size}}.
settings.backupModeLightHint: Without chapter thumbnails, which regenerate on their own the next time you open a chapter (series and volume covers are kept). Estimated size: {{size}}.
settings.restoreSummary: The file contains {{series}} series, {{volumes}} volumes and {{chapters}} chapters.
settings.restoreLightNote: This is a light backup: chapters won't have a thumbnail until you reopen them.
settings.invalidBackupFile: The chosen file is not a valid backup.
settings.unreadableBackupFile: Couldn't read the file: it's not a valid JSON backup.
settings.restoreWarning: The current library (series, volumes, chapters, progress, favorites) will be entirely replaced with the one from the chosen file. This action cannot be undone.
settings.restoreHandleHint: Restored chapters won't be readable right away: handles to physical files can never be exported (they're tied to this browser/device). Re-import the same files after restoring to reconnect them.
settings.restoreSuccess: Library restored. Chapters aren't readable yet: re-import the same files from the Library to reconnect them (they'll be recognized automatically, not duplicated).
settings.startPageHint: Automatic: at launch the Reader opens if you have already started reading, otherwise the Library. It only applies when the app starts.
settings.fullscreenHint: Tapping the middle of the page hides the controls and the Reader covers the whole screen, even Android's status bar (date and time). To go back, tap the middle again or use the system gesture.
settings.fullscreenUnsupported: This browser doesn't allow full screen: the controls hide, but the status bar stays.
settings.threadHint: The strip with the page number when the controls are hidden: visible as before, transparent over the page, or hidden altogether.
settings.pageTurnHint: How moving from one page to the next looks: instantly, with a sideways slide, or turning the page like a book. With the system’s reduced motion setting there is no animation.

pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of the app is available.

readerHome.empty: You haven't started reading yet. This is where the chapter to resume, the ones in progress and the latest read will appear. Import files from the Library or open one from below.
readerHome.hint: If the file is already in the library I recognize it by name: you get your page, bookmark and favorites back. Otherwise I import it and open it.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.resetNote: Only the reading counters (pages read) are reset. Your progress, "Continue reading" and "In progress" stay as they are.
stats.resetDone: Statistics reset. Your reading progress has not changed.

myList.title: My series

empty.fav: No favorites yet. Tap the star next to a series to find it here.
empty.progress: No series in progress. As soon as you start one, you'll find it here.
empty.done: No finished series. Series read to the end appear here, and so do the ones you mark as read by hand.
empty.toread: Nothing to read yet. Tap the + to add a title.

hint.fav: Favorites: series with a star. Tap the star to remove it, the series to open it in the Library.
hint.progress: In progress: series you started and haven't finished. Tap one to resume where you left off.
hint.done: Finished: series read to the end appear on their own; MANUAL entries are the ones you add.
hint.toread: To read: library series you haven’t opened yet, and the titles you add yourself with the +.

myList.editBanner: Edit mode: tap a title to change its title, status and note; the x removes a manual entry, or the star and note of a library series.

delete.title: Remove from the list?
delete.note: “{{title}}” will disappear from the list. Your files and library don't change.

entry.readStateHint: From your reading this series counts as “{{state}}”: the status chosen here only matters until you start it.

errors.duplicate: This title is already in the list.

clear.title: Remove star and note?
clear.note: “{{title}}” stays in the library and in the list, with its reading status: only the star and what you wrote here (note and status you chose) go away.
